name: PILOT
confidence: read from a public-domain score, unchecked
reviewNotes: The melody line read from the Timeless Truths score of Jesus, Savior, Pilot Me (https://library.timelesstruths.org/music/Jesus_Savior_Pilot_Me/, Jesus_Savior_Pilot_Me.xml, whose rights line reads “MUSIC: “Pilot”; John E. Gould, 1871. Public Domain.”); only the tune was taken, not the harmony. Its opening agrees with hymnary.org's incipit 32172 16543 32171 (https://hymnary.org/tune/pilot_gould) and CCEH's mrdtrdls|fmmrdtd (https://www.ccel.org/cceh/0007/x000765.htm). Hand fix: the score sets C–B♭–G on “pilot” (bars 2 and 11) as a quaver triplet, off our semiquaver grid; it is written here as two semiquavers and a quaver (C5:.25 B♭4:.25 G4:.5), keeping the beat and the notes. Gould's dates (1821–1875) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Gould_JE and the year 1871 from the hymnary.org tune page.
